proposal.name: fast-uri
proposal.rationale: The purl explicitly references fast-uri@3.1.9, the version_field is 3.1.9, and the highest-probability candidate (0.588) is 3.1.9. Both E3 and E4 confirm that 3.1.9 and 4.2.3 are valid published versions before the SBOM timestamp. The declared_range of 4.2.3 appears inconsistent with the purl and version_field, so 3.1.9 is the most likely intended version.
